verdict.rationale: Manufact provides an end-to-end publish workflow (checklist audits, protocol compliance checks, autofix) and explicitly supports discovery via a public MCP catalog with browsable checklist scores, plus one-click install/copy-paste configs for clients like Cursor and VS Code — directly matching publish, discovery, and installation by others. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the catalog's discoverability and installation flow in practice, and more detail on how 'others' (non-owners) find and install a published server beyond the one-line catalog mention.
